<!-- Thank you. Any part of this is welcome; leave out what you do not know. -->

**Which part of the model.** The chapter of the course, the example, or the mechanism (for example "chapter 25, the spheroid's arrested region").

**What is wrong, missing or too simple.**

**What the biology says instead.** Papers (a DOI is enough), observations, or your own experience.

**Public data it could be set against.** A dataset and its licence, if you know of one. Please do not attach data about identifiable people.

**What you would expect the model to do.**

**Your background, if you would like to say.** It helps weigh the comment, and is never required.
